استثنوا (form X)
# اِسْتَثْنَوْا (istaṯnaw) /is.taθ.naw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# اُسْتُثْنُوا (ustuṯnū) /us.tuθ.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# اِسْتَثْنُوا (istaṯnū) /is.taθ.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
